privileged_info_for_vlm: The Solent is located at approximately 50.78N, -1.29W. For COLREGS: Rule 13 is Overtaking, Rule 14 is Head-on (reciprocal courses), and Rule 15 is Crossing (vessel on starboard has right of way). In Bridge Command, bc5.ini is the main configuration file. Note that 'radar_range_resolution' is a specific requirement for this task even if not found in standard public docs; the agent must include it as requested.
